newsitem.title: USA: David White agrees to sell company.
newsitem.headline: David White agrees to sell company.

text.p: David White Inc's directors Thursday said the company has entered a definitive agreement to be acquired for $12 a share by a new limited liability company formed by Milwaukee businessman Robert Foote Jr.

The offer will be presented to shareholders at a special meeting, and the annual shareholders' meeting, scheduled for May 6, will be postponed, pending the outcome of the shareholder vote on the acquisition plan, the manufacturer of optical and laser surveying instruments said.

The agreement signed Wednesday by directors calls for Choucroute Partners, a limited liability company managed by Foote, to acquire all of the outstanding shares of David White for about $6 million. Closing of the transaction is scheduled for June 30, David White said.
David White closed at eight on Tuesday and shares have not traded since.
